summary: Truncate partitions lose rows near the minimum int or long. Equality, in and range filters miss them, because the writer wraps the partition value and the scan does not.
Scans on year and month partitions raise OverflowError at 9999-12-31 and 0001-01-01, and filters on inf in a float column return wrong rows.

NOT EXISTS over a nullable foreign key panics in the merge join. On #3617, we showed that concurrent UPDATE, upsert and transfer writes that report success are silently lost on 1.5.1. Indexes matched PostgreSQL across 150 queries on 11 index variants.

AsyncFileSystemWrapper silently discards writes. The simplecache and reference filesystems overwrite on pipe_file(mode="create"). ReferenceFileSystem.find returns sibling keys. ArrowFSWrapper.rm rejects a list.
Redis storage breaks the Storage contract: Iterator returns no keys at 5,000 keys, and IteratorWithRange and Seek ignore their arguments. Memory IteratorWithRange includes its limit.
Makes Memory IteratorWithRange exclude its limit. Adds a regression test.
Temper contract tests across the storage backends.
On pandas[pyarrow], to_dict turns ints into floats and nulls into NaN. On DuckDB and SQLFrame, a select of only literals returns one row per input row.
Three columns read correctly from memory but break after compaction to Parquet: nullable bool reads back false, int32 makes queries fail, repeated uint64 makes compaction fail.
Fixes the three compaction bugs with a regression test.
Adds Temper and the Arrow type lattice that found the bugs.

executemany in autocommit commits nothing on libpq 14+ but commits the rows before a failure on libpq 13. Prepared statements go stale after a repeated DROP or DISCARD ALL. The C loaders wrap very large intervals. Three smaller type bugs. The maintainer closed it.

Rolling and cumulative argmin/argmax return negative indices on main. With flox, groupby any treats NaN as False, and groupby sum and prod apply min_count to integers. Bottleneck breaks argmin ties differently.
SQL Pub/Subs deliver duplicates across a database restart despite ExactlyOnceDelivery. MySQL Publish blocks while a message is unacked. The HTTP Pub/Sub never runs the shared test suite.
Fixes the TestReconnect retry log, which printed a nil error.
Adds an opt-in reconnect-tests input to the shared CI workflow.
The Temper matrix for the SQL Pub/Subs, for reference.
Turns on Kafka's reconnect tests.
Runs Temper beside the SQLFlow coverage gate. The first matrix shows 164 covered and 0 failing cells. Temper found two exemptions whose proving tests did not exist, and the PR adds those tests.

nchunks_initialized and info_complete() raise when a sibling array's name starts with the array's name (lat, lat_bnds), because stores disagree on list_prefix. Byte-range edge cases differ across stores.
